steps.description: [Target Component: Redis Cache Policy] Initiate K6 Load-test execution to deliberately spam `GET /api/v1/dashboard/metrics` with arbitrary hashes overriding cache dimensions.

expectedResults.description: Redis instances mathematically consume 100% capacity triggering the emergency `volatile-lru` fallback policy.

steps.description: [Target Component: Shared Authentication Service] While OOM is ongoing, verify random global user's Session Token stored in Redis DB(0).

expectedResults.description: Auth Tokens definitively persist (zero evictions for critical session keys) and User is NOT falsely kicked.
Dashboard queries securely degrade to MongoDB native aggregation returning `X-Performance-Degraded: true`.
